_README: Amazon Associates picks for HealthyOne blog posts (natural-first since 2026-11-11). scripts/blog_publish.py picks up to 3 products per post by keyword match against the post's slug, title, keywords and tags, or uses the post JSON's optional "affiliate": [search, ...] list. SEARCH links on purpose so discontinued products never 404. Only products listed here are used; never invent queries or tags. Blurbs say what the thing is for, never a health claim (no 'burns fat', no cures). No prescription or telehealth offers here or anywhere on the blog (see scripts/CONTENT_GUIDELINES.md).
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, HealthyOne earns from qualifying purchases. Links on this page may earn us a small commission at no extra cost to you. We only suggest products we believe are genuinely useful.
